name: mcp.hologrow.ai
description:
Hologrow makes your connected commerce, advertising, analytics, and ERP data available for analysis. Explore performance, compare channels, investigate changes, and create reports using natural language.

Hologrow supports a wide range of platforms, including Amazon Seller Central, Amazon Ads, Google Ads, GA4, Meta Ads, GSC, and more. It provides read-only data access and does not modify your campaigns, product listings, orders, store settings, or other source data.

_published_faq.name: How do I add mcp.hologrow.ai to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add mcp.hologrow.ai to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.hologrow.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the mcp.hologrow.ai MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: mcp.hologrow.ai provides these MCP tools: get_data_dictionary, get_freshness, list_platforms, list_tables, query_db, and query_db_analytics.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to mcp.hologrow.ai?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to mcp.hologrow.ai in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
mcp.hologrow.ai requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
mcp.hologrow.ai is developed by Hologrow Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
